message.content:
{
  "screen_decision": "include",
  "screen_rationale": "The study compares multiple murine models of MASLD to human MASLD based on metabolic phenotype, liver histology, and liver transcriptome. It quantifies the agreement using a 'human proximity score' (MHPS), which serves as a measure of concordance between animal model findings and human clinical outcomes.",
  "arm": "disease-biology",
  "arm_evidence": "The study aims to rank murine models based on their 'proximity to human metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD)' by comparing metabolic features, histology, and transcriptomics against human disease.",
  "therapeutic_areas": [
    "metabolic",
    "hepatic"
  ],
  "areas_evidence": "The study focuses on 'metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD)', which is described as the 'hepatic manifestation of the metabolic syndrome'.",
  "model_type": "across-multiple-models",
  "model_evidence": "The study performed a 'wide-ranging retrospective analysis of the most common murine models used in academia and the pharmaceutical industry', evaluating and ranking 39 different MASLD models.",
  "species": [
    "mouse",
    "rat"
  ],
  "species_evidence": "The study compiled data from '509 mice and 89 rats (39 MASLD models and CCl 4 as positive control for isolated fibrosis)'.",
  "endpoint_class": "mixed",
  "endpoint_evidence": "The study integrates metabolic phenotype data, liver histology, and liver transcriptome, which include measures like body weight, blood lipids, liver enzymes, histological scores (steatosis, inflammation, fibrosis), and gene expression changes, representing both hard and biomarker endpoints."
}
